description: This file defines data structures related to paragraph formatting and line info for rendering documents in the MigraDoc library. It includes structs for vertical line measurements, line information, and a class 'ParagraphFormatInfo' that encapsulates formatting details for paragraphs, including methods for managing line information and paragraph state.

classes.name: ParagraphFormatInfo
classes.description: A sealed class that stores formatting information for a paragraph, including line details, paragraph state flags, and methods to manipulate this data.

classes.name: VerticalLineInfo
classes.description: A struct representing vertical measurements of a paragraph line, including height, descent, and inherent line spacing.

classes.name: LineInfo
classes.description: A struct encapsulating information about a specific line within a paragraph, such as width, start/end iterators, line break info, and vertical line info.

methods.name: GetLineInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information for a specific line by index.

methods.name: GetLastLineInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the last line.

methods.name: GetFirstLineInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the first line.

methods.name: AddLineInfo
methods.description: Adds a LineInfo object to the paragraph's line list.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends line info from another FormatInfo object (cast as ParagraphFormatInfo).

methods.name: RemoveEnding
methods.description: Removes the ending line(s) from the paragraph, adjusting internal flags.
